title: Ku70/Ku80 Sensor Complex + Simple DNA DSB
clinicalExplanation: Baseline NHEJ repair: the Ku70/Ku80 ring threads cleanly onto a simple DNA double-strand break, recruiting DNA-PKcs for rapid repair (t1/2 ~ 1-2h).

title: Ku70/Ku80 Sensor Complex + Clustered HZE Lesion (8-oxoG + DSB)
ligandName: Clustered HZE DNA Lesion (8-oxoG + Abasic Site + DSB)
clinicalExplanation: High-LET space radiation (HZE ions / secondary neutrons) creates clustered oxidative lesions near the DSB, causing steric clash inside the Ku70/Ku80 ring and slowing NHEJ repair by ~58%.
countermeasureLink: Immediate STORM_SHELTER ingress reduces secondary high-LET proton/neutron flux by 96%.

title: Keap1 Kelch Domain + N-Acetylcysteine (NAC)
clinicalExplanation: NAC replenishes intracellular glutathione (GSH) and disrupts Keap1-Nrf2 binding, upregulating endogenous antioxidant enzymes before/during Solar Particle Events.
countermeasureLink: Oral radioprotector supplement regimen (Vitamins C, E, Selenium, N-acetylcysteine)

title: Keap1 Kelch Domain + Vitamin C (L-Ascorbate)
clinicalExplanation: Water-soluble free-radical scavenger that neutralizes radiation-induced hydroxyl radicals (•OH) in cytoplasm and reduces 8-OHdG guanine oxidation.
countermeasureLink: Oral radioprotector supplement regimen (Vitamins C, E, Selenium, N-acetylcysteine)

title: Keap1 / Membrane Interface + Vitamin E (alpha-Tocopherol)
clinicalExplanation: Lipid-soluble antioxidant that halts radiation-induced lipid peroxidation (8-iso-PGF2alpha) in cellular and mitochondrial membranes.
countermeasureLink: Oral radioprotector supplement regimen (Vitamins C, E, Selenium, N-acetylcysteine)
